Element grouping Commands.description: Gets the identifier of the group that directly contains each given element. Returns an error for elements that are not part of any group.

Element grouping Commands.name: GetSuspendGroupsMode
Element grouping Commands.description: Gets the current state of the Suspend Groups mode.

Element grouping Commands.name: GetUserDataOfGroups
Element grouping Commands.description: Gets the user data an add-on attached to each given group: its version, platform sign, flags and bytes (base64 encoded). Returns an error for groups that have no user data.

Element grouping Commands.name: SetSuspendGroupsMode
Element grouping Commands.description: Turns the Suspend Groups mode on or off. Suspend groups to perform operations on elements that are part of a group; remember to restore the previous state afterwards.

Element grouping Commands.name: UngroupElements
Element grouping Commands.description: Ungroups the given groups one level, like Edit > Grouping > Ungroup: each group is dissolved, the elements and subgroups it directly contains stay. A group nested in another group is reported as failed; ungroup the containing group first. Returns an execution result per group.

Keynote Commands.name: CreateKeynoteFolders
Keynote Commands.description: Creates keynote folders under the given parent folders (or under the root folder). Available from Archicad 28.

Keynote Commands.name: CreateKeynoteItems
Keynote Commands.description: Creates keynote items in the given parent folders (or in the root folder). Available from Archicad 28.

Keynote Commands.name: CreateKeynoteLabels
Keynote Commands.description: Creates Label elements that reference the given keynote items via autotext. Available from Archicad 28.

Keynote Commands.name: DeleteKeynoteFolders
Keynote Commands.description: Deletes the given keynote folders including their content. Available from Archicad 28.

Keynote Commands.name: DeleteKeynoteItems
Keynote Commands.description: Deletes the given keynote items. Available from Archicad 28.

Keynote Commands.name: GetKeynoteAutoTexts
Keynote Commands.description: Retrieves the autotext tokens of the given keynote items. The tokens can be used as label text content to reference the fields of a keynote item. Available from Archicad 28.

Keynote Commands.name: GetKeynoteTree
Keynote Commands.description: Retrieves the whole keynote folder and item hierarchy. The technical root folder is not included in the output; the top-level folders and items are returned directly. Available from Archicad 28.

Keynote Commands.name: ModifyKeynoteFolders
Keynote Commands.description: Modifies the key, title or reference of the given keynote folders. Available from Archicad 28.

Keynote Commands.name: ModifyKeynoteItems
Keynote Commands.description: Modifies the key, title, description or reference of the given keynote items. Available from Archicad 28.

Solid Element Operation Commands.name: CreateSolidElementLinks
Solid Element Operation Commands.description: Creates solid element operation links between target and operator elements.

Solid Element Operation Commands.name: GetElementTrims
Solid Element Operation Commands.description: Which roofs and shells trim each queried element, with the trim type, and which elements it trims.

Solid Element Operation Commands.name: GetSolidElementLinks
Solid Element Operation Commands.description: Returns solid element operation links for each queried element, grouped by role (target or operator).

Solid Element Operation Commands.name: RemoveElementTrims
Solid Element Operation Commands.description: Removes the trim between an element and the roof or shell trimming it.

Solid Element Operation Commands.name: RemoveSolidElementLinks
Solid Element Operation Commands.description: Removes solid element operation links between target and operator elements.

Solid Element Operation Commands.name: TrimElements
Solid Element Operation Commands.description: Trims construction elements with a roof or shell: the roofs and shells in the list, or one given trimming element with a trim type.

Project Data Commands.name: DeleteProjectData
Project Data Commands.description: Deletes the project data with the given names.

Project Data Commands.name: GetProjectData
Project Data Commands.description: Gets the content of the project data with the given names.

Project Data Commands.name: GetProjectDataKeys
Project Data Commands.description: Lists the project data stored by Tapir in the project: the names, the identifiers of the add-on objects that store them, whether they are kept on this client only and the Teamwork user who has reserved them. Project data is text (for example JSON) saved in the project file by scripts and Grasshopper definitions, such as their settings or the mapping of elements to an external system.

Project Data Commands.name: GrantProjectData
Project Data Commands.description: Grants the project data with the given names, reserved by the current user, to another Teamwork user.

Project Data Commands.name: ReleaseProjectData
Project Data Commands.description: Releases the project data with the given names in Teamwork.

Project Data Commands.name: RequestProjectData
Project Data Commands.description: Requests the project data with the given names in Teamwork from the users who have reserved it, with an optional message.

Project Data Commands.name: ReserveProjectData
Project Data Commands.description: Reserves the project data with the given names in Teamwork, so that other users cannot change it. Returns the users who have already reserved some of it.

Project Data Commands.name: SetProjectData
Project Data Commands.description: Creates or overwrites project data: text (for example JSON) saved in the project under a name. New project data can be kept on this client only, or created as unique so that in Teamwork only one can exist with its name. Prefix the names with the name of your tool (for example 'my-tool/settings') so scripts do not overwrite each other's data.

Analytical Commands.name: GetAnalyticalModelCheckTypeId
Analytical Commands.description: Retrieves the type identifier of the Structural Analytical Model check. Available from Archicad 29.

Analytical Commands.name: GetCurrentAnalyticalModel
Analytical Commands.description: Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model created for the current view. Available from Archicad 27.

Analytical Commands.name: SetAnalyticalGenerationSettingsToNoRule
Analytical Commands.description: Sets the generation settings of the current Structural Analytical Model to no rules. Available from Archicad 27.

Analytical Commands.name: UpdateAnalyticalModel
Analytical Commands.description: Triggers an update of the given Structural Analytical Model, or of the model of the current view when no model is given. Available from Archicad 27.

Revision Management Commands.name: GetCurrentRevisionChangesOfLayouts
Revision Management Commands.description: Retrieves all changes belong to the last revision of the given layouts.

Revision Management Commands.name: GetRevisionChangeCustomScheme
Revision Management Commands.description: Retrieves the custom fields of changes (the change custom scheme): the key and the name of each field. The keys are the customSchemeKey values in the customSchemeData of changes.

Revision Management Commands.name: GetRevisionChangesOfElements
Revision Management Commands.description: Retrieves the changes belong to the given elements.

IFC Commands.name: GetElementsByIFCIds
IFC Commands.description: Retrieves the elements by the given IFC identifiers.

IFC Commands.name: GetIFCAttributesOfElements
IFC Commands.description: Retrieves the IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, PredefinedType, LongName, ...) of the given elements, subelements included: the name, the IFC value type and the value of each attribute. On Archicad 25, 26 and 27 storedOnly returns only the attributes stored on the elements.

IFC Commands.name: GetIFCExportTranslators
IFC Commands.description: Lists the IFC export translators of the project, the preview translator first. Pass one of the names to IFCFileOperation as translatorName.

IFC Commands.name: GetIFCIdsOfElements
IFC Commands.description: Retrieves the IFC identifiers of the given elements.

IFC Commands.name: GetIFCPropertiesOfElements
IFC Commands.description: Retrieves the IFC properties of the given elements.

IFC Commands.name: GetIFCTypeOfElements
IFC Commands.description: Retrieves the IFC types of the given elements.

IFC Commands.name: IFCFileOperation
IFC Commands.description: Executes an IFC file operation: opens or merges an IFC file, or saves the project as an IFC file. A save can name the export translator to use.

IFC Commands.name: RemoveIFCPropertiesOfElements
IFC Commands.description: Removes local IFC properties, given by property set and property name, from elements. Available only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 for now.

IFC Commands.name: SetIFCAttributesOfElements
IFC Commands.description: Sets the values of IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, ...) of elements. The attribute must be one GetIFCAttributesOfElements returns for the element; its IFC value type is kept. Available only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 for now.

IFC Commands.name: SetIFCPropertiesOfElements
IFC Commands.description: Sets local IFC properties on elements by creating or modifying single value (IfcPropertySingleValue) properties in the given property sets. Available only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27 for now.

Teamwork Commands.name: GetLockableObjectSetStatus
Teamwork Commands.description: Returns the Teamwork reservation status of a non-element lockable object set and the users who hold it.

Teamwork Commands.name: GetReservationStatusOfElements
Teamwork Commands.description: Returns the Teamwork reservation status of elements without reserving them: whether each element is free, reserved by the current user or reserved by another user, with the reserving user and the element's owner.

Teamwork Commands.name: GetTeamworkStatus
Teamwork Commands.description: Returns whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and is online, the members of the shared project and who has reserved the Hotlink and XRef management. Works in a solo project too, then isShared and isOnline are false.

Teamwork Commands.name: GrantElements
Teamwork Commands.description: Hands over the reservation of elements to another Teamwork user, given by user id, without a dialog. Available from Archicad 27.

Teamwork Commands.name: ReleaseHotlinkCacheManagement
Teamwork Commands.description: Releases the Hotlink and XRef management in Teamwork mode.

Teamwork Commands.name: ReleaseLockableObjectSet
Teamwork Commands.description: Releases a non-element lockable object set reserved with ReserveLockableObjectSet in Teamwork mode.

Teamwork Commands.name: ReserveHotlinkCacheManagement
Teamwork Commands.description: Reserves the Hotlink and XRef management in Teamwork mode, which is needed before changing hotlink nodes.

Teamwork Commands.name: ReserveLockableObjectSet
Teamwork Commands.description: Reserves a non-element lockable object set (attributes, favorites, project info, project preferences, etc.) in Teamwork mode. The object set is given by its Archicad API name, e.g. 'Composites', 'LayerSettingsDialog' or 'ProjectInfo'.

Teamwork Commands.name: TeamworkReceive
Teamwork Commands.description: Performs a receive operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.

Teamwork Commands.name: TeamworkSend
Teamwork Commands.description: Performs a send operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.

Script UI Commands.name: GetScriptUIResult
Script UI Commands.description: Retrieves and clears the result last submitted from the Script UI palette's page (via window.ACAPI.SubmitResult), if any, and reports whether the palette is still open, so a waiting script can stop when the user closes it.

Script UI Commands.name: ShowScriptUI
Script UI Commands.description: Shows the given HTML content in a native Archicad palette (a tkinter alternative for Python scripts).

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyBeams
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Beam elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyColumns
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Column elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyDoors
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Door elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyLabels
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Label elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyLamps
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Lamp elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyMeshes
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies the attributes of Mesh elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyMorphs
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Morph elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyObjects
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Object elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyRoofs
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies multi-plane Roof elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifySlabs
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Slab elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyTexts
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies standalone Text elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyWalls
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Wall elements based on the given parameters.

Element Modification Commands.name: ModifyWindows
Element Modification Commands.description: Modifies Window elements based on the given parameters.

View Map Commands.name: API.CloneProjectMapItemToViewMap
View Map Commands.description: Clones a project map item to the view map.

View Map Commands.name: API.CreateViewMapFolder
View Map Commands.description: Creates a view folder item at the given position in the navigator tree.

Attribute Commands.name: API.CreateAttributeFolders
Attribute Commands.description: Creates attribute folders. To create a folder, its full path has to be provided. The command will create all folders along the path, if they do not exist.

Attribute Commands.name: API.DeleteAttributeFolders
Attribute Commands.description: Deletes attribute folders and all the deletable attributes and folders it contains. To delete a folder, its identifier has to be provided.

Attribute Commands.name: API.DeleteAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Deletes attributes.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetActivePenTables
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the model view and layout book pen table identifiers.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetAttributeFolderStructure
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed folder structure for the attributes of a given type. If the path is not given, the root folder will be returned

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetAttributeFolders
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed attribute folders identified by their Ids.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetAttributesByType
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the identifier of every attribute of the given type.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetAttributesIndices
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the requested indices and guids of attributes.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetBuildingMaterialAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed building material attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetCompositeAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed composite attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetFillAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed fill attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetLayerAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed layer attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetLayerCombinationAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed layer combination attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetLineAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed line attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetPenTableAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed pen table attributes (including their pens) identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetProfileAttributePreview
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the preview image of each requested profile attribute in a base64 string format.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetProfileAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed profile attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetSurfaceAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed surface attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.GetZoneCategoryAttributes
Attribute Commands.description: Returns the detailed zone category attributes identified by their GUIDs.

Attribute Commands.name: API.MoveAttributesAndFolders
Attribute Commands.description: Moves attributes and attribute folders.

Attribute Commands.name: API.RenameAttributeFolders
Attribute Commands.description: Rename attribute folder.

Layout Book Commands.name: API.GetLayoutSettings
Layout Book Commands.description: Returns the parameters (settings) of the given layout.

Layout Book Commands.name: API.SetLayoutSettings
Layout Book Commands.description: Sets the parameters (settings) of the given layout.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetBuiltInContainerNavigatorItems
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the details of the built-in container navigator items identified by their Ids.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetDetailNavigatorItems
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the details of the detail navigator items identified by their Ids.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetDocument3DNavigatorItems
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the details of the 3D document navigator items identified by their Ids.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetElevationNavigatorItems
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the detailed elevation navigator items identified by their Ids.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetInteriorElevationNavigatorItems
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the details of the interior elevation navigator items identified by their Ids.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetNavigatorItemTree
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the tree of navigator items.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetNavigatorItemsType
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns all navigator item types based on the navigator item identifiers given. An error is returned for each identifier that is not found.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetPublisherSetNames
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the names of available publisher sets.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetSectionNavigatorItems
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the details of the section navigator items identified by their Ids.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetStoryNavigatorItems
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the details of the story navigator items identified by their Ids.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.GetWorksheetNavigatorItems
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Returns the details of the worksheet navigator items identified by their Ids.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.MoveNavigatorItem
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Moves the given navigator item under the parentNavigatorItemId in the navigator tree. If previousNavigatorItemId is not given then inserts it at the first place under the new parent. If it is given then inserts it after this navigator item.

Navigator Tree Commands.name: API.RenameNavigatorItem
Navigator Tree Commands.description: Renames an existing navigator item by specifying either the name or the ID, or both.

AddOn Commands.name: API.ExecuteAddOnCommand
AddOn Commands.description: Executes a command registered in an Add-On.

AddOn Commands.name: API.IsAddOnCommandAvailable
AddOn Commands.description: Checks if the command is available or not.

Element Geometry Commands.name: API.Get2DBoundingBoxes
Element Geometry Commands.description: Get the 2D bounding box of elements identified by their GUIDs. The bounding box is calculated from the global origin on the floor plan view. The output is the array of the bounding boxes respective to the input GUIDs. Only works for elements detailed in Element Information.

Element Geometry Commands.name: API.Get3DBoundingBoxes
Element Geometry Commands.description: Get the 3D bounding box of elements identified by their GUIDs. The bounding box is calculated from the global origin in the 3D view. The output is the array of the bounding boxes respective to the input GUIDs. Only works for elements detailed in Element Information.

Classification Commands.name: API.GetAllClassificationSystems
Classification Commands.description: Returns the list of available classification systems.

Classification Commands.name: API.GetAllClassificationsInSystem
Classification Commands.description: Returns the tree of classifications in the given classification system.

Classification Commands.name: API.GetClassificationItemAvailability
Classification Commands.description: Returns the ids of property definitions available for a given classification item.

Classification Commands.name: API.GetClassificationSystemIds
Classification Commands.description: Returns the list of available classification systems.

Classification Commands.name: API.GetClassificationSystems
Classification Commands.description: Returns the details of classification systems identified by their GUIDs.

Classification Commands.name: API.GetClassificationsOfElements
Classification Commands.description: Returns the classification of the given elements in the given classification systems.

Classification Commands.name: API.GetDetailsOfClassificationItems
Classification Commands.description: Returns the details of classification items.

Classification Commands.name: API.SetClassificationsOfElements
Classification Commands.description: Sets the classifications of elements. In order to set the classification of an element to unclassified, omit the classificationItemId field.

Element Listing Commands.name: API.GetAllElements
Element Listing Commands.description: Returns the identifier of every element in the current plan.

Element Listing Commands.name: API.GetElementsByClassification
Element Listing Commands.description: Returns the identifier of every element with the given classification identifier.

Element Listing Commands.name: API.GetElementsByType
Element Listing Commands.description: Returns the identifier of every element of the given type on the plan.

Element Listing Commands.name: API.GetSelectedElements
Element Listing Commands.description: Returns the identifiers of selected elements in the current plan.

Element Listing Commands.name: API.GetTypesOfElements
Element Listing Commands.description: Returns the types of the given elements.

Property Commands.name: API.GetAllPropertyGroupIds
Property Commands.description: Returns the identifier of every property group in the current plan. The optional propertyType parameter can be used to filter the results based on the type of the property group (Built-in or User Defined).

Property Commands.name: API.GetAllPropertyIds
Property Commands.description: Returns the identifier of every property in the current plan. The optional propertyType parameter can be used to filter the results based on the type of the property (Built-in or User Defined).

Property Commands.name: API.GetAllPropertyIdsOfElements
Property Commands.description: Returns all property identifiers of the given elements. The optional propertyType parameter can be used to filter the results based on the type of the property (Built-in or User Defined).

Property Commands.name: API.GetAllPropertyNames
Property Commands.description: Returns the human-readable names of available Property definitions for debug and development purposes.

Property Commands.name: API.GetDetailsOfProperties
Property Commands.description: Returns the details of property definitions.

Property Commands.name: API.GetPropertyDefinitionAvailability
Property Commands.description: Returns the ids of classification items a given property definition is available for.

Property Commands.name: API.GetPropertyGroups
Property Commands.description: Returns the details of property groups.

Property Commands.name: API.GetPropertyIds
